title: Portable query AST and dialect compilers
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only; higher evidence levels require the named open gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

open_gates: Expand source-specific wildcard, controlled-vocabulary, subheading and line-set conformance against independently reviewed strategies.
assertions.permitted_claim: A portable query model and source-aware compiler are implemented for declared subsets; complete database semantics are not claimed.

open_gates: Complete semantic AST construction beyond the declared source-preserving lexical subsets.
assertions.permitted_claim: Line-numbered native strategy source, spans, diagnostics and raw-source preservation are source implemented; semantic parsing remains deliberately partial.

assertions.statement: Build PubMed/Ovid MEDLINE/Embase/CINAHL/PsycINFO/Scopus/Web of Science corpus
open_gates: Obtain accountable independent information-specialist PRESS review of the digest-bound project-authored fixtures.
assertions.permitted_claim: A seven-dialect source-preservation corpus exists and is statically validated; it is not an external conformance benchmark.

assertions.statement: Add named filter contracts with source/version/citation
open_gates: Obtain accountable methodological and provider-currency review of real filter packs; the checked-in fixture is structural only.
assertions.permitted_claim: Versioned named-filter contracts enforce citation, exact checksums, applicability, expiry, evidence-scaled validation and redistribution decisions; no real filter is methodologically or provider-current validated.

assertions.statement: Add syntax parsers for supported native dialect subsets
open_gates: Implement semantic AST construction, precedence and source-specific node extraction beyond the declared lexical subsets.
assertions.permitted_claim: Seven bounded database-specific lexical subsets are recognised with stable source-spanned unsupported-syntax diagnostics; semantic AST parsing is not claimed.

assertions.statement: Create metamorphic and round-trip translation tests
open_gates: Add parse/compile/parse properties for future semantic native parsers and independently reviewed golden strategies.
assertions.permitted_claim: Compiler JSON round-trip, Boolean reordering, semantic-hash sensitivity and seven-dialect field/truncation/proximity snapshots are compiler-tested; cross-database semantic equivalence is not proven.
